classification.source_level_rationale: points to other records: This unit is a retrospective source study analyzing foreign archival material regarding the Swiss General Staff.
classification.resume: The record is a source study compiled by Hans Rapold containing French-language documents from the French Army's Historical Service concerning the Swiss General Staff and instructions for army intervention in Switzerland, dated 1936–1938. It is a collection of archival materials rather than a primary record of Swiss events. The title also references the Château de Vincennes in Paris.
